hypotheses.title: Cart path depends on one service
hypotheses.explanation: The fixture contains 30 failed cart attempts out of 120 during the fault window. Verify this hypothesis on the actual deployment.

alternatives: Workload or transport failure could also affect cart behavior

recommendations.title: Test bounded timeouts and graceful degradation
recommendations.explanation: Review cart and checkout timeout handling, then repeat the same workload to measure any benefit. No numeric benefit is claimed.

limitations: Fixture-only illustration; no live measured facts
Priority rubric: safety first, affected business operations second, evidence strength third
